answer.explanation: The live configuration of ThumbnailerFunction has OUTPUT_BUCKET set to the non-existent bucket "missing-bucket-lambda-rca", last modified at 02:02:10Z, just before the window. The committed SAM template (intended state) correctly uses !Ref OutputBucket, so live config has drifted from IaC. Commit 44a967f introduced the hardcoded bad value and c5cd710 reverted it in the repository, but the deployed function still has the bad value. Logs in the window show a continuous stream of NoSuchBucket errors on S3 PutObject, about 1,500 errors in 10 minutes, at a steady rate from 02:02 to 02:12. The IAM role permissions and the code are not implicated: the error is a missing bucket name, not AccessDenied, and the handler code is unchanged in this window.
